d: Enjoy all goals and match highlights from Croatia vs Cuba in Group F of the FIFA U-17 World Cup Qatar 2026. Croatia cruised to a 7-0 group stage win at Aspire Zone in Doha as Toni Ruso struck a hat-trick, including a penalty, Izak Jezic scored twice and Vito Jakovljevic and Patrik Lacic were also on target. Croatia top Group F with seven points, while Cuba exit the tournament.
